_source.note: sequence = steps 16..21 of our first turn; the last one is the menu where the turn's manual attachment was decided. The Teal Dance of the active Teal Mask Ogerpon ex was already spent on step 20 (that is the energy it carries).

description: The manual attachment of our first turn with the Teal Dance already spent: active Teal Mask Ogerpon ex at 1 of the 3 Myriad Leaf Shower needs, a Chikorita on the bench and one Grass in hand. The agent charged the Chikorita (8400) because the attachment to the active was vetoed by the first-turn rule.
